northstar: Decide whether one periodic cardinal B-spline coefficient space gives a decisive, practical smooth immersed-wall advantage over the strongest stable local compact derivative plus evaluator at comparable total work, with Fourier-PS as the unrestricted global boundary.
information_boundary: Evaluator construction and certification precede every IBM-CERT wall solve. No wall error, ranking, blocker, or Pareto result may alter an evaluator, route, metric, shift, grid, source, geometry, reference, tolerance, or threshold.

problem.equation: (-div_h grad_h + kappa^2) u = f on the periodic torus, with immersed Dirichlet constraints
problem.marker_rule: theta-uniform, shared per-obstacle count max(48,N/2), closed-curve chord-trapezoid weights
problem.query_rule: same count as markers, interleaved by one half marker phase
problem.bulk_operator: composed div-grad from the route first-derivative symbol in each coordinate
problem.exterior_mask: outside all obstacles and outside one binary-dilation grid layer
problem.reference: existing 768 by 768 Fourier Helmholtz response, translated by periodic coordinate covariance
problem.linear_solve: float64 dense Schur solve with long-double residual accumulation and iterative-refinement floor receipt

evaluators.q12_alias_identity: For q=12, the twelve moment equations on twelve distinct offsets uniquely give L12, so order-matched L12, common L12, and Q12-12 retain separate admitted labels but share one numerical cell and evaluator hash.
evaluators.q_family_definition: For each q, pointwise minimax weights are optimized without wall data on 1025 uniform anchors over delta in [0,1/2]. The fielded Q12-q map is the moment-exact piecewise-linear interpolation of the null-space coordinates over those anchors, reflected by w_r(1-delta)=w_(1-r)(delta). Nodal endpoint weights are imposed. A fixed 64-direction complex-magnitude outer polygon and deterministic HiGHS variable ordering define the optimizer tie handling.
evaluators.objective: min_w max_{|theta|<=2*pi/3} |sum_r w_r(delta) exp(i r theta) - exp(i delta theta)|
evaluators.translation_equivariance: real weights depend only on q and fractional cell coordinate; periodic integer translation changes only the base node

decision_quantities: same-shift compact-over-BMC factors at the finest common grid where both errors exceed ten times their certified floors

timing_contract.aggregation: median of three complete charged solves per distinct primary cell

fallback: If rejected, retain native p+1/p off-grid order, coefficient locality, the exact weighted-adjoint construction, and the Fourier locality boundary; move existing matched-Lagrange wall factors to appendix evidence and do not execute a second experiment family.
